name.zh: 三米代表性石灰岩溶沟石面

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: flat limestone blocks divided by deep solution joints. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：近平坦石灰岩块由深溶蚀裂隙分隔。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

sources.title: Sinkholes

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: representative three-metre-wide landscape outcrop with broad gently inclined limestone surfaces separated by deep continuous dissolution fissures. Unequal curved joint paths, softened shoulders and common lower rock express clints/grikes rather than industrial tiles, polygon columns or enlarged mud cracks. Nominal depth, spacing, crop thickness and gray palette are art choices, not a measured ancient site. Original biomes cave and scale_class landscape retained; no seawater erosion, mapped coastline, exact age or coexisting habitat claim.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 地质形态艺术概念：三米宽代表性landscape露头，平缓宽岩面之间具有深而连通的溶蚀裂隙。不等宽曲折节理、柔化沟肩与共同下部岩体表达岩块/溶沟，区别于工业地砖、多边岩柱或放大泥裂。沟深、间距、截取厚度及灰色配色为美术设定，不是实测古地点。保留原始biomes cave及scale_class landscape，不主张海水侵蚀、海岸测绘、精确年代或共存生境。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
